samcnpc.config.open_world: Open a world to edit its settings.
samcnpc.config.denied: Only the host or an operator may edit.
samcnpc.config.stale: Settings changed; review the refreshed values.
samcnpc.config.locked: Set the global option to Default to edit it here.
samcnpc.config.wait: Please wait a moment before saving again.
samcnpc.config.save_failed: Could not save settings; see the game log.
samcnpc.config.hostilesToNpc.hint: Allow hostile mobs to target NPCs. No clears their NPC targets; it does not prevent incidental damage. Built-in: No.
samcnpc.config.chunkLoading.hint: Keep a moving 3×3 area ticking around each NPC. The existing limit of 64 loaders still applies. Default in both tabs preserves NPC command settings. Built-in: Yes.
samcnpc.config.animations.hint: Enable visible player animations. Disabling them does not change work or combat timing. Default in both tabs preserves NPC command settings. Built-in: Yes.
samcnpc.config.infiniteHealth.hint: Make NPCs immune to damage. Default in both tabs preserves the world's hearts command setting. Built-in: No.
samcnpc.config.toolDurability.hint: Tools and weapons lose durability during NPC block work and attacks. No preserves their durability. Built-in: Yes.
samcnpc.config.ignoreMissingTool.hint: Use a suitable carried tool when available, otherwise work with an empty hand. Vanilla harvest requirements still apply: some blocks drop nothing without a tool. Built-in: No.
samcnpc.config.bareHandsOnly.hint: Always use an empty hand for block work, even when a tool is carried. Takes priority over Ignore missing tool. The held item is kept in inventory; an empty slot is required. Built-in: No.
